## Activity

During January 2020, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 329 captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading review for the month. Staff should continue to ensure that captures are submitted through the usual process and that any operational matters affecting activity are recorded promptly.

## Image quality

A total of 15 image sets were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 4.6 per cent of captures. The clinic should review the circumstances associated with these results and identify any recurring problems affecting image acquisition. In particular, recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 56 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag between photograph capture and grading was 2 days. This measure should continue to be reviewed alongside activity and image-quality findings, as timely grading supports appropriate follow-up. The results for January 2020 should be shared with the clinic team and considered in routine operational review, with attention given to both the ungradable images and the reported referable results.
